case: A standing holder retires while a duty it carries is still live.
why: 05 section 12: retirement is refused while any duty the holder carries is live, and the successor that inherits the address is named. With the live-duty comparison gone, only the successor is demanded -- so the address survives and the duties on the retiring holder do not, which is the outside party losing the party they were reachable through. Coverage note: F6C-16 measured 14 of 30 guards exercised by a paired adverse and benign fixture, and `guard.holder.not_retired_while_duty_live` was one of the sixteen without one -- a guard registered with no adverse fixture is a guard nobody has seen fail.
